status: Source review and proposed bounded test only. No component/solver execution, build, production edit, SHA scan or Git action.
current_source_review: CPU NoSlip callback-gradient patch has no observed sign/index defect in static review: generic q coefficients are minus the physical gradient; the writer uses sigma_B=sigma_mirror-grad(sigma) dot boundnormal, matching legacy dpos=-boundnormal. Each RHS component is independent, so reusing its gradient storage after all three coefficients/value are finished does not alter the next component. Dynamic first-order rejection precedes the writer, making its gradient pointers valid; other four writers ignore the additional pointers. Per-MK selection and existing Mdbc2TangenVel are reused. Velocity interpolation remains current anchored first order, not legacy zeroth order; double stress fitting is not a bitwise legacy clone. No public NoSlip admission follows from this review.

actual_momentum.equation: With J=1, p=0, fixed rho=RhopZero, V0=MassFluid/RhopZero: pair delta_a_i=Vj/rho_i * (float(sigma_i)+float(sigma_j)) * gradW_ij. Effective sigma is explicitly cast to float before this momentum contraction; gradients/receiver accumulation are float, coefficient and stress combination are double. The raw gradient is not multiplied by C. Fluid-fluid then fluid-bound are two separate float accumulations.
actual_momentum.reaction: Fixed Ace is a Darcy acceleration image, NOT a measured wall reaction; InteractionForcesBound writes density rate only. Independent wall reaction must be R_face=-sum over native soil i and actual fixed neighbor slots j on that face of Vi*Vj*(sigma_i^f+sigma_j^f)*gradW_ij. Include actual periodic neighbor copies once per native receiver; aggregate fixed identities by their face/native owner. Never sum periodic receivers as extra mass.

minimum_actual_force_test: Use the existing real 1280-ID, 32x32 soil, x-parallel fixed walls/Z-periodic seed without target offsets; zero gravity/load/damping/HG/artificial stress/DDT/NoPen, existing constant-k u-pl. Admit original global FreeSlip first, then private temporary global NS, global FS and left-NS/right-FS selectors with pointer restoration. Set all true native/periodic fluid J=1, theta=0, p=p0=0, physical v=0, rho=RhopZero, six sigma components zero except sigma_xz=tau=8 Pa (binary exact). Invoke actual Interaction_Forces(INTERSTEP_SymPredictor) once per declared condition, then its normal PosInteraction_Forces; no ComputeStep or Run. Preserve original IDs/geometry/clocks, persistent native fields and fixed markers, check finite buffers and original saturation/natural-domain guards. The proposed test is a zero-step actual-force check, not an initial-value physical solution for every slip option.
independent_oracle: First enumerate actual slot pairs independently of the cell search, using the same explicitly float dx/dz, rr2, actual selected W/C FunSphKernel Fac and float gradients as the operator. Use prescribed tau in the oracle, not blindly the returned ghost sigma: assert native sigma^f_xz=+8, NS boundary sigma^f_xz=+8 and FS boundary sigma^f_xz=-8 after closure. Thus NS boundary pair shear coefficient is 2*tau; FS is zero. Compare every native actual Ace component against this independent raw pair sum. Independently sum pair reactions per face and native fluid resultant. The old WallWave::FaceAndForce at upl_p3_wall_wave_harness_r2.cpp:277-288 provides the ownership/reaction audit pattern, but hardcodes Wendland and is not itself a NoSlip or SH oracle.
budgets_before_execution: Record actual per-native surviving-pair counts nFF/nFB and absolute unrounded pair acceleration terms S_i. With conservative u=FLT_EPSILON and gamma_n=n*u/(1-n*u), use B_i=gamma_(nFF+nFB+3)*S_i+4096*DBL_EPSILON*max(1,S_i); this covers pair float conversion, each local accumulation, the two group additions and the retained double-reference allowance. Binary tau/rho/volume isolate the already-float kernel/gradient rather than adding uncertain material rounding. The regular retained support previously has 36 neighbors, but measure this test's actual count rather than assuming it. For global force/reaction retain the existing bound 128*FLT_EPSILON*pairabs+4096*DBL_EPSILON*max(1,pairabs), provided the measured count/operation bound fits inside it; otherwise reject this proposal before running, do not widen it afterward. Here pairabs is the sum of absolute force magnitudes from the independent pairs. Use componentwise local bounds and the retained vector global bound. No invented continuum reaction percentage gate, solver-completion acceptance or 1D uniform-stress gate.
nonvacuous_expected_outcomes: For positive tau, the reaction on the left NS wall is +z and on the right NS wall -z; each must be nonzero and agree with its independent discrete pair reaction, while the corresponding FS wall shear reaction is zero within the same budget. NS/NS should balance a constant shear stress on the complete regular stencil; preflight the actual lattice raw sum before asserting local a=0. FS/FS deliberately releases incompatible initial shear near each wall: local acceleration need not vanish although the symmetric net fluid force does. Mixed NS/FS generally has a nonzero fluid resultant balanced by its single NS reaction; never demand fluid force alone be zero. Record R/(tau*Lz), Lz=1/16 m, as a qualified continuum/quadrature diagnostic; use the independent discrete sum as the implementation oracle without fitting/rescaling it to tau*Lz.
why_this_is_not_full_mechanics: Correct ghost sigma alone does not prove it enters momentum. This actual-force test checks that path and action/reaction, but v=0 makes viscosity and derivative transport inactive. Fixed wall velocity=0 also makes wall power zero regardless of a wrong reaction, so it is not a useful standalone energy proof.
conditional_next_step: Before accepting transient NoSlip mechanics, one bounded elastic SH pulse may still be needed because zero-step force cannot test the feedback through derivative velocity/stress rate. Reuse geometry/guards, not the old longitudinal u-p pressure-mode oracle: c_s=sqrt(G/rho), not its bulk/Kw coupled speed. Observe incident/reflected characteristic amplitudes before a return from the opposite face: fixed NoSlip gives transverse velocity sign reversal and same-sign reflected shear traction; FreeSlip gives opposite signs. Keep finite/no-exclusion/natural-step and original <=1.1 energy guard, record p/J and actual reactions; no automatic half-step chain or long run. Design its reference/bounds before launching and do not promote zero wall power to proof of the reflection.
